resources.string: City search sends your query to Open-Meteo. Select a result to use its coordinates.
Enter a city name, then Search.
Use one position to resolve a forecast point on this device. Approximate access is enough to try; precise access also permits GPS. City search and saved places work without location permission.
No usable position arrived within 20 seconds. Try again, or use city search or saved places.
Location is disabled or no eligible provider is available. Check location settings yourself, then retry, or use city search or saved places.
Location permission changed. Try again, or use city search or saved places.
Location access was not granted. City search and saved places still work.
Location access is denied. Enable it in app settings if wanted; city search and saved places still work.
Current location selected (reported accuracy ±%1$.0f m). Approximate position can affect which forecast point is nearest.
